metadata.title: Preserving Bamboo Shoots
metadata.description:
Bamboo shoot is one of the indispensable part of tribal Northeastern cooking. It is quite versatile and is used as an ingredient in cooking and as even the main item itself. 
They are used in numerous Northeastern and Asian dishes. They come in fresh, fermented and dried form and each one of them has a distinct flavor. 

Here's how we preserve bamboo shoots for our use.
